member.name: T:AzureAgenticOps.RuleEvaluator.IncidentRuleEvaluator
member.summary: Deterministically evaluates an incident and its evidence against a set of known-pattern rules. No language model is used. When no rule matches, or more than one rule matches, the evaluator never guesses: it reports the incident as unknown or ambiguous and recommends escalation.
